BlameCell.description: One cell of a run's blame stripe. `effect` is `None` for an untested step.
BlameCell.title: BlameCell

CiValue.description: A point estimate with its 95% bootstrap CI. An estimate never appears without one.
CiValue.title: CiValue

ErrorInfo.description: Machine-readable error detail. Never carries a path or secret.
ErrorInfo.title: ErrorInfo

HeadlineResult.description:
Bisect vs. the best judge, each with its own 95% CI, plus the gap
between them with its own paired-bootstrap CI (never a Newcombe interval
over the two accuracies -- they're measured on the same dataset).
HeadlineResult.title: HeadlineResult

MetaPayload.description: `/api/meta`: what data backs this server process, and what built it.
MetaPayload.title: MetaPayload

NotAvailable.description:
A typed placeholder for data `real_repository` cannot yet serve.

Never a stand-in for a real number: any endpoint returning this must
never also invent a plausible-looking value for the same field.
NotAvailable.title: NotAvailable

RerunRow.description: One individual treated/control re-run in the matrix.
RerunRow.title: RerunRow

ResponseMeta.description: Envelope metadata. `simulated` is `True` for every fixture-backed response.
ResponseMeta.title: ResponseMeta

StepPayload.description: The step inspector's detail for one step: messages plus tool call/result.
StepPayload.title: StepPayload
